title: ANZUS Treaty signed
summary: Australia, New Zealand and the United States signed the ANZUS security treaty in San Francisco on 1 September 1951, pledging mutual aid against aggression in the Pacific. It came into force in 1952 and was effectively inoperative from 1986 after New Zealand's nuclear-ships ban.

as_recorded.value: signed in San Francisco, Calif., on Sept. 1, 1951

where.modern_name: San Francisco, California, United States (proxy pin: San Francisco, the location Wikidata lists)

importance.justification: Founding Cold War Pacific security alliance for three countries, with lasting influence on regional defence ties.
